search.hint: Search by vendor, vendor order number or job

assumptions.why: Built by build.mjs from system/model/vendor-order.json and pages/list/vendor-orders.intent.json. Edit those, not this file.
L-name-first: the model says people know one by vendor, vendor order number and job, in that order; codes go to the second line.
L-slot: vendor orders are named after their vendor, a company, but aren't one: the name already says who.
L-name-first: job has its own column, so it isn't repeated on the second line; on a phone, where the columns go, the row's bottom line shows it.

assumptions.value: Order total, Status, Job, Date created, Includes, Created by, Sent, Time approved shown; Vendor, Client, Items, Decline reason hidden
assumptions.why: L-priority: the key figure, the status, then what the intent says people look at, in order (lookAt); the model's other fields stay available, hidden.

assumptions.value: lifecycle: Not sent, Awaiting approval, Approved, Paid (last 30 days)
assumptions.why: L-summary: the page's tasks move vendor orders through 3 statuses, so the summary is the lifecycle; endings count the last 30 days; Declined and Cancelled, rare endings, stay in the Status filter; each adds up order total, the key figure, its count beside.
L-filters: the status (tasks are about statuses) and what tasks find rows by, pinned; kinds, people and the key figure after.
L-sort: what the intent says people look for first.
L-row-click: peek, the system's default; the thing has no full-screen window of its own.
L-related: the records a vendor order connects to in the model (the job's client through it).

assumptions.value: View vendor, View job left out
assumptions.why: L-related: they're the record's links to those records.
The model's actions that work on several at once; the ones that can't be undone confirm, in red (L-risky).
L-create: vendor orders are made by the business.

assumptions.value: Send, Mark approved, Add vendor invoice
assumptions.why: L-next-step: the lifecycle's next step for each status; it leads the record and the ··· menu.
Up to three steps in the record, most used first (the model's order); files, links to related records and the rest under More; what can't be undone last, in red (L-risky).
L-icons: system/model/icons.json, by meaning, record, type, label or verb. Proposed, waiting for review: Mark approved: circle-check, Preview: eye.
